description: Update cvrt-fields settings. github_token is write-only and stored encrypted; a blank or omitted token keeps the stored one. clear_github_token: true deletes it. Returns the settings as fields_get_settings does (token as { set }).

clear_github_token.description: true deletes the stored token (wins over github_token)

github_token.description: GitHub token for plugin updates; write-only, stored encrypted, blank keeps the stored one

name: fields_update_settings
